lib-live.note: optional: add some prefix or icon so it is obvious that a given project/session is a demo. unclear the distinction between a project and a session, but my sense is that most demos should be projects. I also think that demos and scenarios are actually the same thing -- we've just used different wording. and a demo/scenario could be an initial setup, where the user interacts with it, or a fully scripted scenario -- perhaps that's the distinction. but they are two types of the same thing.
